searchText: Yeah we definitely store timing information for each attestation 👍. The schema for p2p attestations is pretty much identical to event stream attestations if you wanted to get an idea for it (we dont publicly publish p2p attestations yet) https://ethpandaops.io/data/xatu/schema/#beacon_api_eth_v1_events_attestation
